name: Fathers Day
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sacred role of fathers and the honoring of parental authority as foundational to a blessed life, as seen in Exodus 20:12 which links honoring father and mother with longevity and blessing. Fathers are also called to lead their households in faithful service to the LORD, exemplified by Joshua’s declaration to serve God rather than false gods. The Lord’s compassion toward His children is likened to a father's tender care, highlighting the divine model for fatherly love and discipline. Furthermore, children are portrayed as a precious heritage from the LORD, underscoring the responsibility fathers have to nurture and guide them in the fear of the LORD, a fear that brings confidence and refuge.
